authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.note: Section 20.4.81 labels the IMAGEDEF parent as a hard owner, whereas this source encodes code C, a relative soft pointer. Recognition retains the actual wire role and does not infer native operations or output semantics.

source.provenance: The project sample script uses AutoCAD SAVEAS 2000; exact producer build and original source provenance remain unverified. Samples are read only and never committed.
source.crossVersion: The paired AC1014 source is recorded in p6-r14-imagedef-relative-owner-wire-2026-11-21.json.

independentObservations.libredwg: LibreDWG dwgread 0.14 reports custom IMAGEDEF 0x8C4, parent code C length 1 offset 2 resolving to 0x8C2, reactors 0x8C2 and 0x8C5, and IMAGEDEF_REACTOR 0x8C5 with parent 0x8C6.
independentObservations.rawDxf: The independently decoded ASCII and binary source records each contain DICTIONARY 0x8C2 entry image group 350 to 0x8C4; IMAGEDEF 0x8C4 reactor references 0x8C2 and 0x8C5 and owner 0x8C2; IMAGE 0x8C6 groups 340/360 reference 0x8C4/0x8C5; reactor 0x8C5 references image 0x8C6.
independentObservations.limitation: These are source graph observations, not native create, save/reopen, erase, clone or WBLOCK tests.

change: Recognize the observed R2000 custom-class code-C parent as KnownSoftPointerOwnerBackReference; do not treat it as hard ownership. Fixed-type IMAGEDEF, undocumented roles, underflow, malformed EED and unqualified output remain refused.

validation.generated: Both production-writer and independent locally authored wire controls exercise R2000 and R14 code C, hard-owner controls, wrong roles, underflow, truncation, fixed-type refusal and exact subsequent reactor spans; unknown R2000 EED with a back-reference is malformed.
validation.asan: The focused legacy wire test passes with the ASan instrumented library.
validation.sourceRefusal: For each AC1014 and AC1015 sample, strict and explicit partial CLI conversion in ASCII and binary reached the explicit unqualified back-reference gate and preserved the pre-existing destination.
validation.sourceScope: The AC1015 source has four unrelated object parse failures and three unmodeled class instances. This is not whole-file output qualification.
validation.regression: Eight rebuilt focused independent wire, raster EED, image dictionary, custom class, reactor metadata and observer profile/fault tests passed.
